summary: End-to-end acceptance of the combined change set (app-wide redundancy reduction + navbar/HUD fix). Validated in a real Chromium via Playwright at both desktop (1280x900) and touch (393x852, isMobile+hasTouch) with reduced-motion, plus static review of auth-gated dashboard/chip flows. PAID_DUELS is ON in this env (running dev server has PAID_DUELS_ENABLED=true and NEXT_PUBLIC_PAID_DUELS_ENABLED=true; home renders the ranked callout). 24/24 acceptance criteria pass. No orphaned destinations: /duel/chips loads and is reachable through the duel-stack shell; the tab band is pixel-identical width (896px, left=187) across /duel, /duel/leaderboard, /duel/chips (the ChipDuelLobby-through-shell fix). The user-reported HUD bug is fixed: on touch /play and /daily there is NO sticky top navbar and the HEIGHT/LAVA CLEARANCE HUD renders at top=20/22px, not covered by any nav (elementFromPoint at the HUD top returns non-nav). /climb keeps its navbar on both touch and desktop. The a11y escape path is real: the Leaderboard tab is keyboard-reachable in 2 Tab presses, is a native role=tab anchor to /climb, and Enter navigates /play->/climb restoring the navbar (no stranding). One initial scripted FAIL (a11y.leaderboardEscape) was a harness wait race, not a product bug — re-run confirmed the Enter-key navigation and navbar restoration succeed.

Intentional ~56px desktop tab-band vertical shift between /climb and /play|/daily — per product/reviewer, NOT failed.

method: Playwright (Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194, --no-sandbox) desktop 1280x900 + touch 393x852 isMobile/hasTouch, reducedMotion=reduce. DOM assertions on live dev server (localhost:3000) — filled-CTA count via className bg-signal (excluding signal-outline) + resolved pathname; tab-band width via getBoundingClientRect on the DUEL_STACK_WIDTH container; HUD visibility via .exp-label rects + elementFromPoint coverage test; navbar via nav.sticky.top-0; a11y via keyboard Tab traversal + Enter navigation with URL assertion. Auth-gated dashboard/chip claim/match paths reviewed statically (no DB/auth in sandbox) — degrade/SignInGate states render.
cleanup: Throwaway Playwright scripts kept in session scratchpad (not repo)
Working tree clean — no next-env.d.ts/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md churn to revert

learnings.insight: Asserting keyboard-activated next/link navigation with a single networkidle wait after keyboard.press('Enter') races the client-side transition and can false-negative (URL still shows the old path). The navigation actually completes.
learnings.action: Use Promise.all([page.waitForURL('**/target'), page.keyboard.press('Enter')]) or re-read page.url() after an explicit settle; don't fail an a11y escape-path check on the first racy read.

learnings.insight: .env.local in this sandbox does NOT contain PAID_DUELS_ENABLED / NEXT_PUBLIC_PAID_DUELS_ENABLED; the paid-on state comes from the already-running dev server's process env (confirmed via /proc/<pid>/environ). A freshly `pnpm dev`-started server without those vars would render paid-OFF (free board only, no ranked callout), changing home/duel acceptance expectations.
learnings.action: Before asserting paid-on criteria, confirm the SERVING process has PAID_DUELS_ENABLED=true (or that the home ranked callout renders); do not assume .env.local reflects the live flag.

learnings.insight: The /duel chips-tier lean teaser correctly preserves the only buy/claim entry: it Links to /duel/chips, which renders the full ChipDuelLobby (daily-claim, stake tiers, Find match) through DuelStackShell section='chips'. No buy/claim capability was orphaned by the redundancy cut.
